name: DSFR for Drupal - Links
description: Applies DSFR recommendations on external links.
project_description: Module relating to "Design Système de l'État" (DSFR) recommendations for external links. It automatically adds target="_blank" to every link Drupal considers external (server-side, via hook_link_alter, not client-side JavaScript), and adds rel="noopener external" plus a translatable "@label - new window" title attribute on links opened in a new window. It also ships a text-format filter (dsfr4drupal_external_links) that applies the same treatment to links inside CKEditor/WYSIWYG content. The module is part of a suite implementing DSFR in Drupal and is intended to be used alongside the base DSFR for Drupal theme.
